DNO Revises Capricorn Energy Bid to All-Cash Offer
By Adam Whittaker
DNO has revised the terms of its offer to buy Capricorn Energy by making it an all-cash offer.
The revised offer from Norway-listed DNO continues to value Capricorn Energy at around $396 million but removes the payment of a special dividend, Capricorn Energy said Thursday.
Under the new terms, Capricorn Energy shareholders will receive $5.214 in cash for each share. This compares with the prior offer of $4.224 in cash, plus a special dividend of $0.99.
Capricorn Energy said the new all-cash offer provides more certainty to investors as it doesn't rely on the payment of the special dividend. It recommends shareholders to vote in favour of the deal.
